stats.done_summary: Implemented the Temporal Stability Index (TSI) calculation from scratch and applied it to the model_output column of the experiment_traces.csv dataset. The calculated TSI for the full series is 0.9684401923117073. Generated visualizations of the time series trace and the distributions of the raw outputs and first differences. Wrote a comprehensive report in report/report.md detailing the methodology, formula, results, and discussion.
